## Destinations

The examples of the
[links and images module](../../../../docs/specs/dialect/links-and-images.md)
whose behavior `M1` and `M2` landed: the `Destination` value of every `Link`
and `Image`, the resolved reference forms, and the inherited and GFM link
forms that produce the `url` branch. They are the module's examples in the
module's order; the reference-image example prints the `width` and `height`
fields that `M7` lands, and the image-dimension examples arrive with `O9`. The
expected dumps are the module's expected dumps in the dump grammar of today,
which does not yet print the universal `anchor` and `attributes` fields that
`M7` lands, so every line differs from the module's by exactly
` anchor=null attributes={}` and by nothing else.

`url` holds the complete semantic destination produced by the inherited
grammar, with backslash escapes and character references decoded and no
percent-encoding, normalization, or resolution, and it may be empty. `title`
is the decoded title, or `null` when none was written; absent and empty
titles remain distinct:

```````````````````````````````` example
[text](/url "title") [a]() [b](<> "")
.
Document scope=1:1..1:37 children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:37 children=5
    ├── Link scope=1:1..1:20 dest=url("/url") title="title" children=1
    │   └── Text scope=1:2..1:5 literal="text" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:21..1:21 literal=" " children=0
    ├── Link scope=1:22..1:26 dest=url("") title=null children=1
    │   └── Text scope=1:23..1:23 literal="a" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:27..1:27 literal=" " children=0
    └── Link scope=1:28..1:37 dest=url("") title="" children=1
        └── Text scope=1:29..1:29 literal="b" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
[a](</u\)x> "t&amp;") [b](/u\)x)
.
Document scope=1:1..1:32 children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:32 children=3
    ├── Link scope=1:1..1:21 dest=url("/u)x") title="t&" children=1
    │   └── Text scope=1:2..1:2 literal="a" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:22..1:22 literal=" " children=0
    └── Link scope=1:23..1:32 dest=url("/u)x") title=null children=1
        └── Text scope=1:24..1:24 literal="b" children=0
````````````````````````````````

## Resolved references

Every successful full, collapsed, and shortcut form produces the `Link` its
definition names, with the definition's destination and title and the
occurrence's own scope; the definition produces no node, and a reference whose
label resolves to no definition is the inherited literal text with its
brackets:

```````````````````````````````` example
[text][r] [r][] [r] [text][none]

[r]: /url "title"
.
Document scope=1:1..3:17 children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:32 children=6
    ├── Link scope=1:1..1:9 dest=url("/url") title="title" children=1
    │   └── Text scope=1:2..1:5 literal="text" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:10..1:10 literal=" " children=0
    ├── Link scope=1:11..1:15 dest=url("/url") title="title" children=1
    │   └── Text scope=1:12..1:12 literal="r" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:16..1:16 literal=" " children=0
    ├── Link scope=1:17..1:19 dest=url("/url") title="title" children=1
    │   └── Text scope=1:18..1:18 literal="r" children=0
    └── Text scope=1:20..1:32 literal=" [text][none]" children=0
````````````````````````````````

The first definition of a label in source order wins among duplicates:

```````````````````````````````` example
[r]

[r]: /first
[r]: /second
.
Document scope=1:1..4:12 children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:3 children=1
    └── Link scope=1:1..1:3 dest=url("/first") title=null children=1
        └── Text scope=1:2..1:2 literal="r" children=0
````````````````````````````````

## Autolinks (extension)

Angle-bracket autolinks and the three GFM bare forms produce
`Link(dest=url(...), title=null)` with the link text as content; an email
destination carries the inherited `mailto:` prefix and a `www.` destination
the inherited `http://` prefix:

```````````````````````````````` example
<https://x.y> https://x.y/z www.x.y x@y.z <x@y.z>
.
Document scope=1:1..1:49 children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:49 children=9
    ├── Link scope=1:1..1:13 dest=url("https://x.y") title=null children=1
    │   └── Text scope=1:2..1:12 literal="https://x.y" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:14..1:14 literal=" " children=0
    ├── Link scope=1:15..1:27 dest=url("https://x.y/z") title=null children=1
    │   └── Text scope=1:15..1:27 literal="https://x.y/z" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:28..1:28 literal=" " children=0
    ├── Link scope=1:29..1:35 dest=url("http://www.x.y") title=null children=1
    │   └── Text scope=1:29..1:35 literal="www.x.y" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:36..1:36 literal=" " children=0
    ├── Link scope=1:37..1:41 dest=url("mailto:x@y.z") title=null children=1
    │   └── Text scope=1:37..1:41 literal="x@y.z" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:42..1:42 literal=" " children=0
    └── Link scope=1:43..1:49 dest=url("mailto:x@y.z") title=null children=1
        └── Text scope=1:44..1:48 literal="x@y.z" children=0
````````````````````````````````

A bare URL or `www.` run is opaque from its first byte to its terminator: a
code span or emphasis delimiter that begins inside the run is URL text, an
`<` ends the run, and a bare autolink never accepts an attribute container:

```````````````````````````````` example
https://x.y/*a* www.x.y/`b`. https://x.y/<b>c</b> https://x.y{.c}
.
Document scope=1:1..1:65 children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:65 children=10
    ├── Link scope=1:1..1:14 dest=url("https://x.y/*a") title=null children=1
    │   └── Text scope=1:1..1:14 literal="https://x.y/*a" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:15..1:16 literal="* " children=0
    ├── Link scope=1:17..1:27 dest=url("http://www.x.y/`b`") title=null children=1
    │   └── Text scope=1:17..1:27 literal="www.x.y/`b`" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:28..1:29 literal=". " children=0
    ├── Link scope=1:30..1:41 dest=url("https://x.y/") title=null children=1
    │   └── Text scope=1:30..1:41 literal="https://x.y/" children=0
    ├── HTML scope=1:42..1:44 literal="<b>" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:45..1:45 literal="c" children=0
    ├── HTML scope=1:46..1:49 literal="</b>" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:50..1:50 literal=" " children=0
    └── Link scope=1:51..1:65 dest=url("https://x.y{.c}") title=null children=1
        └── Text scope=1:51..1:65 literal="https://x.y{.c}" children=0
````````````````````````````````

The run is decided at its own position, so surrounding delimiters still match
around it, and no bare form is recognized inside link text:

```````````````````````````````` example
*https://x.y* [https://x.y](/u) (www.x.y)
.
Document scope=1:1..1:41 children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:41 children=6
    ├── Emphasis scope=1:1..1:13 children=1
    │   └── Link scope=1:2..1:12 dest=url("https://x.y") title=null children=1
    │       └── Text scope=1:2..1:12 literal="https://x.y" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:14..1:14 literal=" " children=0
    ├── Link scope=1:15..1:31 dest=url("/u") title=null children=1
    │   └── Text scope=1:16..1:26 literal="https://x.y" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:32..1:33 literal=" (" children=0
    ├── Link scope=1:34..1:40 dest=url("http://www.x.y") title=null children=1
    │   └── Text scope=1:34..1:40 literal="www.x.y" children=0
    └── Text scope=1:41..1:41 literal=")" children=0
````````````````````````````````
